description: This file defines the interface and class for Android's Media Resource Manager Service, including resource management, client handling, and process priority functions.

classes.name: ResourceManagerService
classes.description: Main class implementing Android's media resource management, handling resource allocation, client management, and process priority.

classes.name: ResourceManagerService::SystemCallbackInterface
classes.description: Interface for system callbacks related to video and CPU resource management.

classes.name: ResourceInfo
classes.description: Struct representing information about a resource held by a client.

classes.name: ProcessInfoOverride
classes.description: Struct for process info override details including cookie and client reference.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource manager service.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the resource manager service.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs diagnostic information about the service.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client from resource management.

methods.name: reclaimResource
methods.description: Attempts to reclaim resources from lower priority processes.

methods.name: overridePid
methods.description: Overrides process ID for resource management.

methods.name: overrideProcessInfo
methods.description: Overrides process info such as priority and oom score.

methods.name: markClientForPendingRemoval
methods.description: Marks a client for pending removal.

methods.name: reclaimResourcesFromClientsPendingRemoval
methods.description: Reclaims resources from clients marked for removal.

methods.name: notifyClientCreated
methods.description: Notifies that a client has been created.

methods.name: notifyClientStarted
methods.description: Notifies that a client has started.

methods.name: notifyClientStopped
methods.description: Notifies that a client has stopped.

methods.name: notifyClientConfigChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a client's configuration has changed.
